description:
Searches the words of every poem in the ReadingRate collection and returns the matching lines, the lines around each, and each poem's anchor, which get_poem, save_poem_line and annotate_poem_line accept.

Use when the user half-remembers a line, or wants poems that mention an image or a subject, such as "the poem about the shattered statue in the desert". It returns only poems already in the collection; it does not write, continue or translate poems.

It matches words, so a remembered phrase works better than a paraphrase. The poems are in English: for a reader writing in another language, search with the English words a poem would use, explain in the reader's language, and quote the poem's lines in the original English rather than in a translation of your own.

Example: {"query": "the woods are lovely dark and deep"}

poem_id.description: Search one poem only: its anchor or slug, as for get_poem

query.description: A line, a phrase, or the words remembered

name: search_poems

note.description: Guidance when the query could not match (e.g. written in a non-English script)

results.description: Matching passages, most similar first. Empty when nothing matched.

anchor.description: Pass to get_poem, save_poem_line or annotate_poem_line

context.description: The match with the two lines either side, newline separated

line.description: Verse line number of the match

title: Search poems
